results.notes: Four normal interleaved observations, one retained injected observation and one separate intrusive diagnostic per arm/input/admission. This chart uses only four normal observations. Equivalent completed requests/s is eight/region wall, NOT allocation throughput or production request throughput. Region includes fixed application mutation and checks plus eight actual blocking full collections; two warmups and one cleanup full call are outside it. Managed commitment is not native log commitment or process private bytes. LXR admission is fixed at24/64/128MiB, while built-ins are characterization, not equal-heap fairness. Stock observations are repeated across mode checkpoints, not newly measured. CPU/wall effects are mixed/noisy; no throughput win, production-tail, P1.7 or full parity claim. Unsupported metrics remain null; the H128 log payload still commits512MiB. The Linux H128 flat-reference-mature injected effect is negative/inconclusive and retained, not retried.
